name: Ekaal Web Management API - Phase 3 LiteClient Collection

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: Verifies server is alive and returns status ok

endpoints.name: Dashboard Overview
endpoints.description: Fetches aggregated receivables, payables, top debtors, and subscription alert

endpoints.name: List Customers
endpoints.description: Lists customer receivables ledger with optional search, status, and sort filters

endpoints.name: Create Customer
endpoints.description: Creates a new customer account initialized with zero balance

endpoints.name: Customer - Add Debt (DEBT_ADD)
endpoints.description: Increases customer totalDebt and balance

endpoints.name: Customer - Log Payment (DEBT_PAYMENT)
endpoints.description: Increases customer paid and decreases balance

endpoints.name: List Vendors
endpoints.description: Lists all suppliers with balance owed

endpoints.name: Create Vendor
endpoints.description: Registers commercial supplier and initial accounts payable balance

endpoints.name: Pay Vendor
endpoints.description: Subtracts settlement amount from vendor totalOwed

endpoints.name: List Products
endpoints.description: Lists inventory stock items and aggregate inventory valuation metrics

endpoints.name: Create Product
endpoints.description: Adds product item and auto-computes margin = sellingPrice - unitCost

endpoints.name: Update Product
endpoints.description: Updates inventory parameters and recalculates margin

endpoints.name: Reseller Utility Dispatch
endpoints.description: Records telecom utility resale dispatch and logs netAmount = amount + profit

endpoints.name: Reseller History
endpoints.description: Fetches recent reseller transactions stream

endpoints.name: Broadcast - Dispatch SMS Notification

body.message: Ogaysiis: Fadlan xasuuso inaad iska bixiso deymaha kugu xusan muddo 3 maalmood gudahood ah. Mahadsanid!

endpoints.description: Dispatches message to recipient IDs strictly enforcing <= 125 characters limit

endpoints.name: Broadcast Logs
endpoints.description: Fetches broadcast transmission logs

endpoints.name: Subscription Plans
endpoints.description: Fetches active pricing tiers: 1_MONTH ($2.99), 6_MONTHS ($14.99), 12_MONTHS ($29.99)

endpoints.name: Subscription Activation
endpoints.description: Activates plan and advances merchant expiration date (30 / 180 / 365 days)

endpoints.name: Get Merchant Profile
endpoints.description: Fetches store metadata, support contact channels, and subscription info

endpoints.name: Update Merchant Profile
endpoints.description: Updates merchant store profile and support channels
